title: SQL Language
description: Vendor-aware SQL reference covering relational modeling, SELECT, joins, grouping, windows, subqueries, set operations, writes, constraints, transactions, indexes, plans, security, migrations, and production query design.

subtopics.title: Tables, Keys, Constraints & NULL
subtopics.description: Rows model facts; keys identify them; foreign keys maintain relationships; NULL means missing/unknown and uses three-valued logic.

callouts.title: NULL Is Not Equal to Anything
callouts.text: Use IS NULL / IS NOT NULL. NOT IN with a NULL in its set can become unknown; prefer NOT EXISTS for anti-joins.

subtopics.title: SELECT, Filtering, Ordering & Pagination
subtopics.description: SQL is declarative and results are unordered without ORDER BY. Stable pagination needs a deterministic unique tie-breaker.

codeBlocks.code:
SELECT id, created_at, total
FROM orders
WHERE customer_id = :customer_id AND status = 'paid'
  AND (created_at, id) < (:cursor_time, :cursor_id)
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY;

callouts.title: Keyset Pagination Scales Better than Large OFFSET
callouts.text: Use the ordered key tuple as a cursor. OFFSET still scans/skips rows and can drift under concurrent changes.

subtopics.title: INNER, OUTER, SEMI & ANTI Joins
subtopics.description: Choose joins from desired row preservation and cardinality. Unexpected duplication usually means the join relationship was not understood.

table.title: Join Semantics
rows: Left rows with at least one match

subtopics.title: GROUP BY, Windows & Set Operations
subtopics.description: Aggregates collapse groups; windows compute across related rows while preserving detail; UNION removes duplicates while UNION ALL preserves and is cheaper.

codeBlocks.code:
SELECT customer_id, created_at, total,
       row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS recency,
       sum(total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS lifetime_total
FROM orders;

subtopics.title: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE & MERGE/UPSERT
subtopics.description: Constrain every write with keys/predicates, use parameter binding, inspect affected rows, and prefer atomic database operations over read-then-write races.

codeBlocks.code:
UPDATE accounts
SET balance = balance - :amount
WHERE id = :id AND balance >= :amount;
-- require exactly one affected row

callouts.title: Always Preview Broad Writes
callouts.text: Run the WHERE clause as SELECT, use a transaction, verify affected row count, and ensure a recovery path before mass UPDATE or DELETE.

subtopics.title: ACID, Isolation & Locks
subtopics.description: Transactions group invariants; isolation controls concurrency anomalies; locks and MVCC are implementation-specific. Keep transactions short and retry documented transient failures.

subtopics.title: Indexes, Sargability & Query Plans
subtopics.description: Indexes trade write/storage cost for access paths. Keep indexed columns directly searchable, match composite order to predicates/sort, and inspect actual plans with representative data.

subtopics.title: Security, Portability & Checklist
subtopics.description: Bind values rather than concatenate SQL, grant least privilege, distinguish vendor syntax, version migrations, and deploy schema changes compatibly.

callouts.title: Production Checklist
callouts.text: Model keys/constraints, name columns explicitly, handle NULL, parameterize, use deterministic ordering, inspect plans, keep transactions short, set timeouts, test migrations/rollback, and monitor slow queries.
